# ESS to Attend Sidoti Micro-Cap Virtual Conference 20026


May 14, 2026


ESS, Inc. CEO Drew Buckley will participate in one-on-one investor meetings and will also host a presentation from **2:30 PM ET to 3:00 PM EDT in Track 1** . Buckley will be discussing recently reported quarterly results, recent validation of the company’s technology, and advancing commercial opportunities.


**Sidoti Virtual Micro-Cap Virtual Conference**


**Wednesday, May 20, 2026**


**Presentation: 2:30 – 3:00 PM ET in Track 1**
**Webcast** :[Click here](https://sidoti.zoom.us/webinar/register/WN_tykYfq99SmCm_LmWvJAK0g#/registration)


For more information on the Sidoti Micro-Cap Virtual Conference, or to schedule a one-on-one meeting with Drew Buckley, please contact your conference representative or you may also email your request to[\[email protected\]](https://essinc.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection) or call Chris Tyson at (949) 941-8235.


[Register Here](https://www.sidoti.com/events/may-sidoti-micro-cap-virtual-conference-2026)
